facility_desc: 1.5M sf (as reported) fulfillment center, Day Hill Road area; $101M project (Amazon Fulfillment Services)
program: Town of Windsor five-year real property tax abatement (avg 60%, starting at 70%) and building permit fee reduction (~$500k per EDC report)
notes: UPGRADED to primary. Minutes: Council approved a fixed assessment agreement with Amazon.com.dedc LLC as an economic development incentive (main motion 8-1-0, Deputy Mayor Simon opposed; debate was 60% vs 50% abatement over a five-year period) and, separately 8-1-0, a one-half reduction of building permit fees, repayable if the facility is not built to at least $60M real property value by 2015-09-30. Deputy Mayor said Amazon asked for a $4M tax subsidy. The dollar amount 3.9M is NOT in the minutes: it is the Patch figure (secondary). Patch: saves Amazon about $3.9M; council approval 2013-10-21. HBJ 2013-08-29: EDC recommended 60% + 10% tied to wages/green design; Amazon had asked 80%; permit fee cut about $500k (not in 3.9M); 380 jobs in 5 years, $100-110M. Town minutes not retrieved. Site match: BDL1/BDL2 at 200 Old Iron Ore Rd.

facility_desc: 823,000 sf distribution/fulfillment hub at 1201 Kennedy Rd and 1 Joseph Lane (developer Scannell Properties); $230M
program: Town of Windsor three-year 50% real property tax abatement and 50% building permit fee reduction
notes: UPGRADED to primary. Minutes: Council resolved 9-0-0 to authorize a fixed assessment agreement with Amazon.com Services, LLC (three-year declining abatement, real estate only, on average 50%) plus a 50% reduction of the upfront building permit fee; improvements due by 2021-10-01; the 7-year 100% abatement Amazon sought was never agreed. Town expected over $30M revenue over seven years; parcel then paid $114,000/yr. The dollar value 8.78M is NOT in the minutes: it is the Hartford Business Journal projection (secondary; Courant 2020-06-02 gives the 3-year 70% first-year structure). HBJ 2020-06-16: projected total savings $8.78M = $7.48M property tax + $1.3M permit fees. Amazon had sought 7 years at 100% (about $4-5M/yr). Town to receive about $10.52M in the 3 years. Town minutes not retrieved. Site: 1215 Kennedy Rd in facility list matches 1201 Kennedy Rd on city and street only.
